note: PROPOSAL ONLY. Ops are against rules.json (keyed by quest EditorID). `merge_params` merges into the existing rule of that kind; `add_rule` appends; `add_quest` creates the quest entry (tier/questline given) and its rules follow as add_rule ops. origin for all of these would be "proposed"/"curated" once accepted.

params_schema.stages: list[int] stage numbers that are mutually exclusive outcomes

new_kinds.why: Stages merge as max (MASTER-PLAN merge rules). nVPrimmDeputyConv endings 110/120/130 and VNipton 30 (rescued) / 35 and 70 (failed) are alternatives, not progress: if two outcomes race (two initiators, or a player action against an NPC death script) the highest number wins instead of the first. No existing kind expresses this.
new_kinds.engine_work: synccore Merge: for a rule-listed stage set, the first committed SetStage in host order wins; later ones in the set are rejected (host) / ignored (clients) and counted. Game-free, unit-testable.

params_schema.markers: list[EditorID] map marker REFRs whose ShowMap reveal is shared by the whole party

new_kinds.why: `ShowMap <marker>` (17 occurrences in this questline, e.g. VMQ01 stage 40/50/100, Beagle journal answer) reveals a map marker and unlocks fast travel for the player. There is no Effect type, no capture hook and no applier call; without it the party sees different maps and objective targets differ. Closest existing kinds (FastTravelLock, ShareKarmaRep) do not cover discovery state.
new_kinds.engine_work: new Effect `SetMapMarkerVisible{marker, visible}` (state, host order, merge = OR), capture at the ShowMap command handler / marker visibility flag, apply via the marker visibility byte (GetMapMarkerVisible is already read by VMQ01QuestScript).

ops.why: VMQ01QuestScript polls `GetHasNote` in its GameMode block to advance the quest (Jessup note -> SetStage VMQ01 100 + VMQTops 10; Beagle journal -> objectives 36/38). Quest scripts run on the host only, so without a reduction the host character's notes decide.

The three notes that drive VMQ01 are picked up from bodies/containers (VMQ01NoteObjectSCRIPT OnAdd player) or added by AddNote; every player must end up with them (owner decision: quest items duplicated). Pickup is not a script command: needs the container-transfer observer (gaps.md, blockers #1 and #2).
VMQ01 stages 40, 50 and 100 reveal Novac, Boulder City and Freeside through ShowMap; new kind, see new_kinds.

Persuading the hostage Beagle (Speech >= 25) makes him join the PLAYER faction and follow (BeagleFollow). He follows the recruiter, not the host. SetPlayerTeammate itself is not used; the follow is AddToFaction playerfaction + package state.
The three sheriff endings are alternatives (NCR sergeant, Meyers, reprogrammed Primm Slim). Max-merge would let the highest win after a race; see new_kinds.
Primm Slim repair parts are paid by the initiator who reprograms him (INFO 173886 begin), not by the whole party.

The sheriff petition is a chain of notes (PrimmSheriffPetition0..5) replaced via AddNote/RemoveNote as signatures accumulate in shared quest variables (PetitionActive, NCRPetition, NoteNumber). The notes must follow the shared counter on every player.
Stage 26 reveals the NCR Correctional Facility and Mojave Outpost; the Beagle answer to "people who passed through" (INFO 1618BD/1618BE) reveals Nipton and Novac.
Rescued (30, complete) vs captives killed (35, stopquest) vs failure (70). The captive death scripts and the rescue trigger can race across machines.

CraigBoone's Nipton reaction (stage 30: `CraigBooneREF.SayTo player ...` gated by VNPCFollowers.bBooneHired) and his dependency script read GetPlayerTeammate; Boone belongs to whoever hired him (CompanionOwner is the companion line's rule).
The quest script moves Victor from Goodsprings to Novac when the player enters region vMapVictorInNovacRegion. Any party member entering the region must trigger it (host-only evaluation otherwise).
T2 dialogue container (no rules.json entry today). Its INFO result scripts mutate shared quests (VMQ01, nVPrimmDeputyConv 20/26, VMS02 35) and take caps/parts from the player.
